system.name: SEER
system.one_liner: an online context-learning rollout subsystem that speeds up synchronous LLM reinforcement learning via divided rollout, context-aware scheduling, and grouped speculative decoding

components.name: Request Buffer
components.role: provides a global view of pending and in-progress rollout work, tracking request chunks

components.name: Context Manager
components.role: logically centralized manager maintaining group-level contextual views and driving scheduling/draft decisions

components.name: Divided Rollout Scheduler (§4.2)
components.role: breaks each request into smaller schedulable units for fine-grained placement

components.name: Context-aware Scheduler (§4.3)
components.role: uses learned length context to approximate a longest-first policy reducing tail latency

components.name: Grouped Draft Server (§4.4)
components.role: builds group-level speculative decoding and adjusts draft lengths adaptively

components.name: Inference Engine Pool
components.role: hosts multiple model-serving instances backed by a distributed KVCache pool

components.name: Instance 1
components.role: a model-serving instance holding request chunks

components.name: Instance 2
components.role: a model-serving instance holding request chunks

components.name: Instance 3
components.role: a model-serving instance holding request chunks

components.name: Instance N
components.role: a model-serving instance shown with KVCache load/offload and speculative draft interaction

components.name: Draft Client
components.role: per-instance client participating in grouped speculative decoding

components.name: KVCache Load/Offload
components.role: moves KVCache between hierarchical storage tiers for an instance

components.name: KVCache Pooling with Hierarchical Storage
components.role: distributed KVCache pool spanning GPU and CPU tiers, enabling migration across nodes without recomputation

components.name: Async Batch API for Clients
components.role: asynchronous client-facing interface for submitting rollout requests

content.key_idea: SEER's rollout subsystem coordinates a Request Buffer and a Context Manager (running divided-rollout scheduling, context-aware scheduling, and grouped speculative decoding) above an Inference Engine Pool with hierarchical GPU/CPU KVCache pooling, separating ordinary request flow from a distinct context flow used for scheduling and speculation.
content.reading_order: Top to bottom: Async Batch API and Request Buffer at top exchange request states with the Context Manager on the right, which drives scheduling and speculative decoding on the Inference Engine Pool instances below, each spanning GPU and CPU KVCache tiers.

summary: This figure gives the overview of SEER's rollout subsystem for fast synchronous LLM reinforcement learning. Three tightly connected components are shown: a Request Buffer giving a global view of pending and in-progress rollout work via chunk state (Spec. Req., Completed, In-flight, Unscheduled); a Context Manager housing three techniques (Divided Rollout Scheduler §4.2, Context-aware Scheduler §4.3, Grouped Draft Server §4.4) that drive scheduling and draft-generation decisions; and an Inference Engine Pool of model-serving instances backed by a distributed, hierarchically stored (GPU/CPU) KVCache pool, each instance running a Draft Client for group-level speculative decoding. The diagram distinguishes ordinary Request Flow (solid black arrows) from Context Flow (dashed red arrows) used for state syncing, scheduling and speculation, with an inline legend explaining the chunk-state color/hatch coding. It is a dashed-bordered, hatch-filled box diagram organized top-down from client-facing request handling to the GPU/CPU inference pool.
